content_sections.heading: About District Court Alappuzha
content_sections.text: The District Court, Alappuzha issued this notification under the signature of District Judge Honey M Varghese. The posts are in the Fast Track Special Court at Haripad in Alappuzha district.

content_sections.heading: District Court Alappuzha Office Attendant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notification names the second post as Computer Assistant, but the application form lists L.D Typist-1 in its list of posts and does not mention Computer Assistant. content_sections.heading: District Court Alappuzha Office Attendant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: The upper age limit for appointment is 62 years. The application form asks for age as on 1 October 2026, along with the date of birth. Service background: The posts are meant for staff who retired from similar or higher posts in the Judicial Departments or other departments. This condition applies to all the posts and follows two government orders: G.O.(Rt) No. 73/2020/SJD dated 12.02.2020 65/2020/SJD dated 06.02.2020 The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

rows.event: Last date for the application to reach the office

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on contract basis. It runs for a continuous period of 179 days at a single stretch, subject to the terms and conditions. Appointees are liable to be terminated on attaining the age of 62. Applicants are included in a panel and considered for appointment from it.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Court Alappuzha Office Attendant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the proforma attached to the official notification (PDF) . Tick the post you are applying for and affix a recent passport size photo. Fill in your name, age as on 01.10.2026 and date of birth. Enter your Pension Payment Order (PPO) number, date of retirement, and designation and office at the time of retirement. Give your total period of service in the cadre, permanent address, address for communication and contact number. Sign the declaration that the details are true, and enter the place, date and your name. Make sure the application reaches the office of the District Court, Alappuzha on or before the deadline.

faq.question: Q1. Can a person who has never worked in government apply?
faq.answer: No. Applications are invited only from retired employees of the Judicial Department or other departments, and the form asks for a PPO number and date of retirement.

faq.question: Q2. Can someone retired from a department outside the judiciary apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Staff from other departments can apply if they retired from a similar or higher post.

faq.question: Q3. Is the deadline the last date to post the application?
faq.answer: No. The application must reach the office by 3.00 pm on 3 November 2026, so the date of sending does not meet the condition on its own.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: The appointment is for a continuous period of 179 days at a single stretch, subject to the terms and conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What happens when an appointee turns 62?
faq.answer: The appointee is liable to be terminated on attaining the age of 62.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the selected staff work?
faq.answer: They will work in the Fast Track Special Court, Haripad, in Alappuzha district.

faq.question: Q7. Which post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Office Attendant has 2 vacancies. The other two posts have 1 each.

faq.question: Q8. Is Computer Assistant the same post as L.D Typist?
faq.answer: The notice does not link the two names directly. The notification says Computer Assistant, while the proforma offers L.D Typist-1 as the option to tick.
